relations.label: 'jam dbyangs shakya gzhon nu (3894) active at gsang phu gling smad (6158)
relations.zotero_refs:
[R894SIKE]: 400 (de rjes 'jam dbyangs shAkya gzhon nus me pho stag nas lo nyi shu rtsa bdun gdan sa mdzad). Was abbot for 27 years. Reading "me pho stag", this would be from 1266 to 1293, but this would not fit with the dates of the Third karmapa. Likely dates would be 1278 (sa pho stag) until 1305. 
[R894SIKE]: 582 (de nas gsang phu gling smad kyi gdan sa shAkya gzhon nu la dbu ma'i skor mang po dang | byams chos lnga | mngon pa gong 'og dang sa sde | tshad ma la sogs mang du gsan |). Taught the Third Karmapa Rang byung rdo rje (ID: 3897) in gSang phu gling smad.
[MPRU5QUC]: 209. Abbot of gSang phu ne'u thog monastery (eighth abbot of lower college) for 27 years.
[CCSBSVCA]: 190, n. 455 and 230-231, n. 630 suggests he occupied the chair from ca. 1326 to 1352, or 1266 to 1293.
[R894SIKE]: 622 (de nas gsang phur byon nas bla chos ba 'jam dbyangs shAka gzhon dang | zur chos pa slob dpon blo gros mtshungs med la gtugs nas mtshan nyid kyi sde snod sa sde lnga dang | byams chos lnga dang | tshad ma rnam nges dang | sdud pa dang spyod 'jug la sogs pa mang du zhus |). Was main preacher in gSang phu when the first Zhwamar pa (ID: 6161) came to study with him, i.e., between 1308 and 1315.
[U9BU5AFU]: 1050. Founded sGros rnying. Succeeded 'Jam dbyang 'Od zer mgon po (ID:3893).
